title: Apple Reaches Deal With Brussels on European HomeView, Report Says
summary:
Apple agreed with Brussels on a European edition of its $299 HomeView smart display after making multiple concessions, MacGeneration reported Tuesday.

The report followed Apple's announcement earlier that day that HomeView would not be sold in the European Union because Siri AI was unavailable on iOS there. Apple said it was "working constructively with the EU."

HomeView uses facial recognition to personalize content for up to six people and supports Apple apps, FaceTime and smart home controls. The 7 inch display is available for preorder in tabletop and wall mounted versions, with shipments beginning November 13. Apple also unveiled cameras, doorbells, locks and thermostats developed with LG and Schneider Electric, arriving in December.
